name: align-rebase-like-reorder
description: Two captured edits (e1 rewrites step one, e2 rewrites step three). Afterwards the file is reordered as a rebase or a reset-and-reapply could do, with no captured edit: the second half moves to the top (`A B C D` becomes `C D A B`). Rule 5 procedure: all four texts are unique on both sides, but there are two chains of the same maximal length (A B and C D) and no anchor belongs to EVERY maximal chain, so nothing is matched. All four lines are Unknown(noCapture), even though the text of every line is exactly a line the replay had. Claiming either pair as the unmoved one would be a guess.
